arguments.content: Recovery phase does not establish that the latest submitted payload is active. When the API explicitly allows edited values on retry after receipt failure and the provider replaces values idempotently, skipping apply for an 'applied' record acknowledges stale values. Compare current retry values to the saved payload or reapply the latest submitted values and synchronize the recovery record before marking completion. Regression probe: apply blue, fail receipt, retry same ID with red; success must leave red active. Reproduced in service.py; P1.
